dict.string: Impo uses your city for personal briefs and, when enabled, adds nearby places to Echo while you record, including with the screen locked. Only place names, recording-time context, and location accuracy are shared with Impo and its AI service. Coordinates are not sent to Impo.

When you hold the input field, Impo records your voice message and sends it to Impo and Google Gemini to turn it into text. When you tap Echo, Impo records audio, including while your iPhone is locked, and sends it to Impo and Google Gemini to create transcripts in Memories. Tap Stop to end recording.
Impo uses your local network to connect to your private personal agent server.
When you ask about your schedule, Impo reads matching events. In Live chat, event details are sent to the Impo server and our AI service to answer you. Impo does not change your calendars.
When you ask, Impo reads your reminders and adds the reminders you request. Relevant reminders are sent to the Impo server and our AI service to answer you.
When you ask about someone, Impo looks them up in your contacts. Matching contact details are sent to the Impo server and our AI service to answer you. Impo does not change your contacts.

When you ask about your activity or sleep, Impo reads the Health data you choose. In Live chat, relevant summaries and sleep samples are sent to the Impo server and our AI service to answer you. Impo does not write Health data.
Impo only reads the Health data you choose to share and never saves or changes anything in Health.
